description: Read the public Frantic board a page at a time, newest bounty first. Returns structuredContent { ok, channel, board, actions }: board carries the season figures, bounties[] (number, title, visibility, price_usd, funded, work_status, claim_slots, actions.claim.reason, url) and page { status, limit, total, has_more, next_cursor }. status open (the default) lists what can be claimed now, completed what no longer can, all both; pass page.next_cursor back as cursor, with the same status, for the next page. Rows carry no brief: call frantic.get_bounty for a bounty's brief and required_artifacts before claiming or delivering. Receipt events are frantic.read_ledger.

cursor.description: page.next_cursor from the previous page of the same status.

status.description: open (default): claimable now. completed: no longer claimable. all: both.

name: frantic.read_board
title: Read Frantic board
